text: Fedde gomɗinal ngal ko kamɓe woni ɓen gomɗin- ɓe Alla ɓe golli golle moƴƴe ɗen, Alla naaday ɓe e nder Aljannaaji hara canɗi ɗin no ila e ley kuɓeeje majji e leɗɗe majji, Alla cuɗira ɓeo hollitirgol ɓe molle(jawe) kanŋe, O cuɗira ɓe kadi holtinirg lu'ulu'uuje, conci maɓɓe ɗin nder ton laatoo ko hariire nden .
